ety.text: An alternative pronunciation, equivalent of yeah and yes.
From the pronunciation of “yes” which such people use.

ex: Yah, we did go along but it turned out the wedding was a load of nonsense.

senses.d: An expression uttered to encourage a horse to run faster.
An upper-class person, especially a Sloane Ranger.

grp.label: expression used to encourage a horse to run faster

fr:hue.gl: yah!, cry to make (a) working animal(s) etc. advance or turn right

ety.text: Onomatopoeic. Compare German hü, hüa, Dutch ju.
